title: Level Hardscapes
summary: A client landing for a premium outdoor-living studio. Dark field, architectural type, material photography, not a SaaS product shot.
alt: Brand board for Level Hardscapes on a black field, with the wordmark, color swatches, and a do and don't list.

sections.heading: The field
body: Every line on the page points at hardscape. The palette, the do and don’t, and a single CTA sit on a black field so the photography can carry the claim.

sections.heading: What stays out
body: The board is the client piece: palette, type, and a do and don't list on a black field, with one ask. Anything that does not point at the hardscape stays off the page so the photography can carry it.

title: Intermission
summary: A health dashboard that treats labs as a quiet grid of hormone, metabolic, cardio, reproductive, and sleep scores, instead of a portal dump.
alt: Phone screen of the Intermission dashboard for Nadia, age 34, with six health scores in a quiet grid.

sections.heading: The view
body: The still is Nadia’s view: a name, an age, and six scores that can be read in a glance. Color stays in the tiles. The chrome stays out.

sections.heading: Range and watch
body: I designed it so a marker that needs a look sits next to one that is already in range, without turning the phone into a clinic clipboard.

title: Boardwalk Bots
summary: An agent workspace for a construction BD team. Meridian writes the morning digest, scores call-today projects, and only spends enrichment credits after you approve a record.
alt: Boardwalk Bots desk for Westland Construction, with a call-today list, the Meridian project in the center, and routines on the right.

sections.heading: The desk
body: Westland Construction is the sample desk. The left rail is the stack: call today, enrich, CRM. The center is one project at a time, with a reason it matched.

sections.heading: Credits after you ask
body: Routines on the right run the market scan and the CRM write. Contact lookup stays locked until someone asks. Empty lookups are not charged.

title: Food Passport
summary: A junior field-series passport. Kids log foods; the cover line is stay curious, not finish the plate.
alt: Food Explorer Passport cover with a yellow explorer stamp, a blank name line, and the line stay curious.

sections.heading: The cover
body: Food Explorer Passport is a blank name line, a yellow explorer stamp, and a lot of paper. It is a field guide, not a chore chart.

sections.heading: The line
body: The cover type is stacked and plain on purpose. The only color is the stamp. You do not have to like every food.

title: Offramp
summary: A seven-question diagnostic that turns what an owner already knows into a picture of exit readiness. The still is Hudson Mechanical mid-assessment.
alt: Offramp diagnostic for Hudson Mechanical, with an exit-readiness map around the business and completed diagnostics on the right.

sections.heading: The map
body: The map around “your business” is the whole product: exit target, earnings, customer risk, owner dependence, records, revenue trend, timeline.

sections.heading: Resume
body: Completed diagnostics stay on the right so an owner can compare later. Resume picks up at the step they left, here owner dependence, step three of seven.

title: Philo Shirt
summary: A Philo merch frame. CONNECTLECT, builders backing builders. Cream center stack, black ink, cassette-deck geometry.
alt: Philo shirt graphic on black, cream center stack with two reels, a signal line, and a DIN jack.

sections.heading: The print
body: The tee is a center print: two reels, a signal line, and a DIN jack. It is a schematic, not a logo lockup.

sections.heading: One ink
body: Cream on black, one ink, no extra marks. The caption is the thesis: find the signal, sharpen it.

title: brand.brand
summary: A product for agencies and in-house teams: one brand guide humans and agents can both read. Edit free; pay when you publish.
alt: brand.brand page for the Citrus Pear workspace, with a brand guide, a voice panel, and a publish price.

sections.heading: The page
body: The marketing page is the product: a guide with a Brand Agent, a voice panel, and a publish price. Citrus Pear is the sample workspace.

sections.heading: Publish
body: Structured brand data, a generated URL, and a brand.json token for external agents. I designed the page so the free plan and the publish license sit in the same column.
